method: Full wall: setup, graph capture, loop, native snapshots, all final E/H, point trace and selected output transfers. Three planar monitors with 65 frequencies by default. All time samples retained, float32 fields/complex64 DFT. Flux-only modes accumulate four tangential components per plane and export the same signed flux as the six-component full-output mode. The same selective fused DFT observer is supplied to unmodified flaport E/H updates. External graph sizes 1 and 8 both measured. Native graph size 1 and fixed cohort size 4. One warmup and three alternating-order measured repetitions by default. Cold compilation/context, checks and disk writes excluded. Torch allocated/reserved peaks exclude CUDA context, graph executables and other non-Torch allocations.

gates.native_common_outputs: bitwise versus independent full-output native runs
